import ssl

import pytest

from ansible.module_utils import urls


def test_make_context_accepts_list_and_string(mocker):
    context = mocker.Mock()
    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'create_default_context', return_value=context)
    urls.make_context(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'AES128-SHA'])
    context.set_ciphers.assert_called_once_with('ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:AES128-SHA')
    context.set_ciphers.reset_mock()
    urls.make_context(ciphers='HIGH:"'!aNULL'"')
    context.set_ciphers.assert_called_once_with('HIGH:"'!aNULL'"')


@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [[], '', 1, ['valid', 2], ['']])
def test_make_context_rejects_bad_type(ciphers):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers must be'):
        urls.make_context(ciphers=ciphers)


def test_make_context_rejects_unsupported_without_echo(mocker):
    context = mocker.Mock()
    context.set_ciphers.side_effect = ssl.SSLError('sensitive input')
    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'create_default_context', return_value=context)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Invalid or unsupported TLS ciphers') as error:
        urls.make_context(ciphers='sensitive input')
    assert 'sensitive input' not in str(error.value)


def test_request_uses_cipher_context_for_http_redirect(mocker):
    context = mocker.Mock()
    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'get_ca_certs', return_value=(None, bytearray(), []))
    make_context = mocker.patch.object(urls, 'make_context', return_value=context)
    opener = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'build_opener')
    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
    urls.Request().open('GET', 'http://example.invalid', ciphers='HIGH')
    make_context.assert_called_with(cafile=None, cadata=bytearray(), ciphers='HIGH', validate_certs=True)
    handlers = opener.call_args[0]
    assert any(isinstance(handler, urls.CustomHTTPSHandler) and handler._context is context for handler in handlers)

def test_request_uses_cipher_context_with_unix_socket(mocker):
    context = mocker.Mock()
    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'get_ca_certs', return_value=(None, bytearray(), []))
    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'make_context', return_value=context)

    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
    urls.Request().open('GET', 'http://example.invalid', unix_socket='/tmp/test.sock', ciphers='HIGH')
    handlers = opener.call_args[0]
    assert any(isinstance(handler, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler) and handler._context is context for handler in handlers)


def test_get_ca_certs_explicit_file(tmp_path):
    cafile = tmp_path / 'ca.pem'
    cafile.write_bytes(b'')
    path, cadata, checked = urls.get_ca_certs(str(cafile))
    assert path == str(cafile)
    assert cadata == bytearray()
    assert checked == [str(cafile)]
